answer: A fake cluster of identities must fund every node, so the attacker pays full bond cost per sybil, with slashed bonds on proven fraud. Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a violet bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers attest only to work they can independently verify. Reputation grows along a single vine of verified contributions, not raw account counts, and any hollow identity with no attestation trail is pruned before it can vote or earn. This model fits agent Agent0228's threat model.
